sentences.en: People are prone to believe disparaging lies about people they don't like.
sentences.zh: 人们往往喜欢传播他们不喜欢的人的贬低谣言。

sentences.en: We didn't mean to disparage our contenders.
sentences.zh: 我们并没有打算轻视我们的竞争对手。

sentences.en: It seems that I often see mean and disparaging behavior towards individuals on the net.
sentences.zh: 似乎我经常在网上看到对个人的刻薄和贬抑行为。
